versions.content: ModeSwitchAck ExecutableEntitys as direct function call Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00143, SRS_Rte_00213 The RTE generator shall support invocation of a ModeSwitchAck ExecutableEn- tity via direct function call , if all following conditions are fulfilled: • the asynchronous mode switch procedure is configured according to [SWS_Rte_07173] or [SWS_Rte_08905] • the ModeSwitchAck ExecutableEntity is not mapped to an OsTask (see [SWS_Rte_06798] and [SWS_Rte_06800]).
